Simple-kernel normal form projects exactly to \(-\kappa a^3\) with \(\kappa>0\) and standard center-manifold strong-stable foliation, yielding sharp \(t^{-1/2}\) except measure-zero strong stable set. The three-agent coordinate decoupling and \(U=q^{-2}\) series prove the \(-\frac25\log t\) term. Exact checker and numerical integrator support independent algebra; proof, not finite test, establishes the infinite conclusion.

value.rationale: The published strict signed-Laplacian stability test does not decide the natural mixed-topology zero-eigenvalue boundary. A global boundary theorem and model-specific asymptotic coefficient quantify how long disagreement persists there, while the three-agent logarithmic term and exponential exception distinguish qualitatively different trajectories at the same stable consensus. These are motivated critical social-network dynamics, not arbitrary parameter arithmetic.
